claim: Separating secondary lookup from the common leaf-hit path makes the native cache improve coherent reads.
mechanism: E1 assembly shows a leaf-index lambda call in the cache variant's timed read loop. A small forced-inline entry point and non-inlined miss helper keep that call off last-leaf hits.
prediction: All paired split/stock read time ratios below one on coherent64; no unconditional leaf-lambda call on last-leaf hits in assembly.
falsification: Mixed paired directions, consistently higher time, or a surviving unconditional per-read helper call.
change: Preserve the original native membership predicate and tree traversal fallback; move secondary lookup into an explicit miss helper.

claim: The cache with a separate miss helper and saturated-mask guard improves native coherent writes.
mechanism: Combine the small common leaf-hit path with the two cache and mask choices; native safety callbacks remain active.
prediction: All paired split_both/stock write time ratios below one on coherent64.
falsification: Mixed directions or higher time. Counterexample regressions require an optional policy rather than a universal recommendation.
change: Enable the explicit miss helper and mask guard in a combined native build.
